SETUP_CODE.description: Required. A one-time code Zomfy pairs with: make one with `openssl rand -hex 16` and keep it for Settings → Bots → Relay.

DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID.description: Discord (optional): **General Information → Application ID** of your app at [discord.com/developers](https://discord.com/developers/applications). Leave empty to turn Discord off.

DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Discord: **General Information → Public Key** (64 hex characters).

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Discord: **Bot → Reset Token**. Turn on **Message Content Intent** on the same page.

SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.description: Slack (optional): the **Bot User OAuth Token** (`xoxb-…`) of the app made from `apps/relay/slack-manifest.yaml` (README, "Slack"). Leave empty to turn Slack off.

SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET.description: Slack: **Basic Information → App Credentials → Signing Secret**.

GITHUB_APP_ID.description: GitHub (optional): your GitHub App's **App ID**. Easiest: leave the four GITHUB_* empty here and run `bun run deploy --github` later, which makes the app and sets them (README, "GitHub").

GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: GitHub: the app's private key (the whole `.pem`, line breaks kept or written as `\n`).

GITHUB_APP_SLUG.description: GitHub: the app's slug, as in github.com/apps/<slug>; people ask with @<slug>.

LINEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Linear (optional), one of two ways: a **personal API key** (`lin_api_…`; comments then come from you). Leave empty when you use LINEAR_CLIENT_ID and LINEAR_CLIENT_SECRET (README, "Linear").

LINEAR_CLIENT_ID.description: Linear, the other way: your OAuth app's client id, with **Client credentials** turned on (comments come from the app).

LINEAR_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Linear: that OAuth app's client secret.

LINEAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Linear: the signing secret of the webhook to `<worker URL>/linear/webhook` (Issues, Comments, Issue labels). Leave empty to turn Linear off.

EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Phone push notifications (a later phase): leave empty.
